title: Controlling Jealousy at Work
paragraphs: When a colleague received the promotion Hadeel had been hoping for herself, she felt a wave of jealousy that surprised her with its intensity, since she genuinely liked the colleague as a person.

Rather than acting on these feelings by being distant or unkind, Hadeel privately reflected on why the disappointment felt so sharp, realizing it was more about her own uncertainty than anything her colleague had done.

She made a conscious decision to congratulate her colleague sincerely, and surprisingly, expressing genuine happiness for someone else's success gradually softened her own disappointment over the following weeks.
Hadeel later admitted to a mentor that suppressing jealousy through kindness, rather than pretending it did not exist at all, helped her process the emotion in a healthier way.
